readme: One entry per place, in order. Swap a photo by changing src and small (same file names keep working too). edge: where the back edge of the counter is in the photo, 0 top to 1 bottom. stand: where the device's foot stands. focus: the part of the photo to keep in the middle, 0 left to 1 right. zoom: photo height as a multiple of the card height. still: the device on its own, for the version without motion. screen: one of the names in js/screens.js. light: optional overrides of the pose's light (js/stage.js, POSE).
caption: Places are AI-generated illustrations. The device is our live 3D model.
